nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: The only place URLs and the model live. Everything downstream reads from here.

nodes.name: Get Watchlist
nodes.notes: The watchlist lives in JobOS, not here. Adding a company must never mean editing this workflow.

nodes.name: Greenhouse Feed
nodes.notes: Public per-company JSON feed. No credentials, no scraping.

nodes.name: Lever Feed
nodes.notes: Public per-company JSON feed. No credentials, no scraping.

nodes.name: Crawl Career Page
nodes.notes: One page, once. check_robots_txt is what keeps that promise enforceable rather than merely intended — do not turn it off.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ urls: [$json.target], crawler_config: { cache_mode: 'bypass', check_robots_txt: true, page_timeout: 45000 } }) }}

nodes.name: Extract Job Links
nodes.notes: Deterministic on purpose. Measured against llama3.2:3b on this exact step: regex found 30/30 links in 0.2ms, the model found 24/30 in 199s.

nodes.name: Ollama — Relevance
nodes.notes: The model's one job: judge relevance by meaning, where a keyword match cannot. It is never asked to extract the links — that is what the previous node is for. CPU inference: allow minutes, not seconds.

nodes.name: Send to JobOS
nodes.notes: Runs once per source, so each one records its own last_run_at and last_error. Idempotent — re-running the whole watchlist re-imports nothing.
